task: Coordinate a manual bump of the k8s.io/sigs.k8s.io module set from 0.36.2/0.36.0 to 0.36.4, resolve the genproto split-module ambiguity that blocks even a single-module patch bump, and extend the dependabot.yml ignore rule to cover semver-patch too (part of #26)

events.summary: Scoped to go.mod/go.sum (coordinated k8s.io/sigs.k8s.io + genproto bump), THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md (regenerated because module versions changed), and .github/dependabot.yml (extend the existing minor/major ignore to also cover semver-patch, with an updated comment). Explicitly out of scope: no code changes in internal/**, no replace/exclude directives, no chart/CRD changes (make generate produced no diff), no compatibility-matrix.json change (it tracks k8s minor lines, not exact patch versions, and the k8s minor line is unchanged at 1.36/0.36).

Reproduced the defect named in the task: `go get k8s.io/api@v0.36.4 && go mod tidy` in this worktree upgraded k8s.io/api and k8s.io/apimachinery to v0.36.4 alone, then `go mod tidy` failed with dependency_file_not_resolvable -- ambiguous imports for google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/api/expr/v1alpha1, googleapis/rpc/errdetails, googleapis/rpc/status, and googleapis/api/httpbody, each found in both the old genproto umbrella module (v0.0.0-20200526211855-cb27e3aa2013) and the newer split genproto/googleapis/{api,rpc} modules, reached through sigs.k8s.io/controller-tools' test dependency on k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver -> k8s.io/apiserver -> cel-go/otel/grpc-gateway. Confirms even a PATCH bump of a single k8s.io module cannot be done in isolation. Reverted go.mod/go.sum from a backup copy before proceeding.

D1: identified every k8s.io/sigs.k8s.io module in the transitive graph that follows the 0.36.x line via `go list -m all | grep k8s.io/` (api, apimachinery, client-go, apiextensions-apiserver, apiserver, code-generator, component-base, kms, streaming) and confirmed each has a v0.36.4 tag via `go list -m -versions`. D2: ran a single coordinated `go get` for all nine modules to v0.36.4 together (not one at a time), which pulled in an updated google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/{api,rpc} v0.0.0-20260831171406-... and google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.12 as part of the same dependency resolution -- resolving the genproto ambiguity as a side effect of the coordinated bump rather than needing a separate `go get google.golang.org/genproto@latest` step. D3: `go mod tidy` completed with no errors and no further diff on a second run (idempotent).

go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum: clean (no diff after a second tidy). go mod verify: 'all modules verified'. make build: succeeded. make vet: clean. gofmt -l .: no output. make test: full suite passed (internal/agent, internal/ui, internal/util, and all other packages). go test -race -count=1 ./internal/agent/...: ok, 8.061s, no race detected. make generate (controller-gen deepcopy + CRD): produced no diff -- confirms the k8s.io/apis version bump did not change generated code shape. make license (bash scripts/ci/check-third-party-licenses.sh write) regenerated THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md; a follow-up `check` run reported 'THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md is up to date.' and `go tool go-licenses check ./... --allowed_licenses=...` passed with only non-fatal warnings about non-Go assembly files it can't inspect (pre-existing, unrelated to this change). python3 hack/validate-compatibility-matrix.py: OK, 9 entries -- left unmodified since it records k8s minor/architecture status, not exact patch versions, and the k8s minor line (1.36) is unchanged. python3 -c 'import yaml;yaml.safe_load(open(".github/dependabot.yml"))': parsed cleanly after the ignore-block edit. make lint could not run locally (golangci-lint binary not installed in this environment); left to CI.
events.scope: Build, vet, gofmt, full unit test suite, a targeted -race run on internal/agent, code generation idempotency, license manifest regeneration and check, compatibility-matrix schema validation, and dependabot.yml YAML validity. Does not cover a live Dependabot run against the updated ignore rule, and does not exercise quota enforcement against a real prjquota-mounted filesystem -- every quota binary remains stubbed via CommandRunner in these tests, per CLAUDE.md.

events.summary: D4: extended .github/dependabot.yml's existing k8s.io/*+sigs.k8s.io/* ignore block (which already covered semver-major and semver-minor per PR #116) to also ignore semver-patch, since e2's reproduction proved the coordinated-set constraint applies at the patch level too -- Dependabot's per-module resolver cannot produce the multi-module `go get` this fix required. Rewrote the block's comment to name the new failure mode (genproto ambiguity via controller-tools test deps), the run that surfaced it (33662842079), and point at this PR as the manual-bump precedent, while keeping the pre-existing #26/#108/compatibility-matrix rationale and the security-PR-suppression NOTE from PR #116 intact.

The k8s.io/sigs.k8s.io module set is bumped from 0.36.2/0.36.0 to a uniform 0.36.4 across all nine modules that follow that line, the genproto split-module ambiguity is resolved as a byproduct of the coordinated go get (no replace/exclude directives needed), THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md is regenerated and verified up to date, and dependabot.yml now blocks Dependabot from ever re-proposing a single-module k8s.io/sigs.k8s.io bump at any update-type severity (major/minor/patch), documenting why. make generate produced no diff and the compatibility matrix needed no update since the k8s minor line is unchanged.

Complete at the build/vet/test/race/generate/license/compat-matrix/YAML verification level described in e4. Unverified: quota enforcement against a real prjquota-mounted host was not exercised -- every quota binary is stubbed via CommandRunner in these tests, per CLAUDE.md's gotcha on this exact point. Also unverified: golangci-lint (binary unavailable locally, deferred to CI) and whether the updated dependabot.yml ignore rule is accepted and behaves as intended on Dependabot's next scheduled run against the live repository.
